coordinates.locator: Centroid of OSM way 907808191 "ORNL Spallation Neutron Source" complex boundary
coordinates.note: Centroid of the OpenStreetMap outline of the whole SNS complex (way 907808191, "ORNL Spallation Neutron Source"); it marks the complex, not any building or hall inside it, and the 800 m precision is the size of the outline. An earlier version of this record used the ORNL-wide ROR point, 7 km from the complex; the outline centroid replaced it on 2026-09-21 (a move of 3484 m).

name: Spallation Neutron Source (SNS) accelerator and target complex
notes: The marker is a campus-grade point (centroid of the complex outline), not a surveyed position of any structure.

summary.plain: The Spallation Neutron Source site at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Tennessee: the long proton linac, the accumulator ring and the target building where the proton beam hits liquid mercury to make neutrons (and, as a by-product, neutrinos).
summary.technical: Site record for the SNS accelerator and target complex; its marker is the centroid of the OpenStreetMap outline of the complex (about 0.7 x 1.4 km). Experiments inside it have their own records: COHERENT's detectors stand in the basement hallway "Neutrino Alley" (site:ornl-sns-neutrino-alley), whose own position is not published.
